newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh 96/97 GDP growth seen at 5.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh 96/97 GDP growth seen at 5.7 pct.

text.p: Bangladesh's gross domestic product (GDP) is expected to grow by around 5.7 percent in fiscal 1996/97 ending on June 30, Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria said on Wednesday.

"We expect a higher growth this year as Bangladesh's macro-economic situation is satisfactory," Kibria told Reuters. "We had set the growth target at 5.5 percent for the year. Fortunately the rate will be more than 5.7 percent."
GDP in Bangladesh grew by 4.7 percent in 1995/96 and 4.4 percent in the previous year.
